parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.tenant_id, c.name AS channel_name, t.name AS tenant_name FROM channels c JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.type = 'whatsapp' AND c.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'active' AND c.config->>'instance_name' = $1::text LIMIT 1;

WITH sel AS (SELECT id AS contact_id, name FROM contacts WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid AND phone = $2::text), ins AS (INSERT INTO contacts (tenant_id, name, phone, status) SELECT $1::uuid, COALESCE($3::text, 'Contato WhatsApp'), $2::text, 'active' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sel) RETURNING id AS contact_id, name) SELECT contact_id, name FROM sel UNION ALL SELECT contact_id, name FROM ins LIMIT 1;

WITH sel AS (SELECT id AS conversation_id, status FROM conversations WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid AND contact_id = $2::uuid AND channel_id = $3::uuid AND status IN ('open', 'pending') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), ins AS (INSERT INTO conversations (tenant_id, contact_id, channel_id, status, ai_enabled, priority) SELECT $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, 'open', true, 'normal' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sel) RETURNING id AS conversation_id, status) SELECT conversation_id, status FROM sel UNION ALL SELECT conversation_id, status FROM ins LIMIT 1;
